purpose: Read-only reference mappings for Minecraft 1.6.4 / MCP 8.11; stored under local ignored cache, not part of source snapshots.

mapping_release.compatibility_evidence: Historical Forge configuration and support record identify MCP 8.11 as the 1.6.4 MCP archive.

caveats: The CSV rows contain Searge name, MCP name, side and optional description; they do not encode owner classes or JVM descriptors. Use them for identifier renaming only after owner/signature matches are established from SRG and recovered bytecode.
Two rows per target identifier differ by side column; the readable MCP name is identical.
The repository mirror is not an official source. Its bytes are pinned by the SHA-256 above and independently match the MD5 expected by the historical Forge setup.
No executable or tool from the archive was run.
compatibility_evidence: Archive conf/version.cfg explicitly identifies MCP 8.11 and both client/server Minecraft 1.6.4; the historical Forge record corroborates the archive hash.
